summary_1line: Drona and Arjuna fight an awe‑inspiring duel of celestial weapons, after which Dhrishtadyumna advances toward Drona amid fair battles among surrounding warriors.

image_candidates.scene_text: Drona and Arjuna stand on their chariots unleashing blazing celestial weapons that illuminate the sky while gods and sages watch from the clouds.
The earth trembles and oceans surge as Drona raises the Brahma weapon, only for Arjuna to counter it with a radiant Brahma weapon of his own.
Dhrishtadyumna drives his chariot like a blazing fire toward Drona while Nakula and Sahadeva shield him, battling Kritavarman and his brothers.
